code:
SELECT j.name, h.step_name, h.run_date, h.run_time,
       h.run_status,  -- 0=Failed 1=Succeeded
       h.message      -- 2=Retry  3=Canceled
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON j.job_id = h.job_id
WHERE j.name = N'Nightly Full Backup'
ORDER BY h.run_date DESC, h.run_time DESC;
caption: Only has rows for jobs Agent actually attempted to run.
